title: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Oats
description: Creamy oats with whey, banana and a swirl of peanut butter — a big protein breakfast.
steps: Cook the oats with the milk until creamy.
Stir in the whey off the heat with a splash more milk.
Top with sliced banana, peanut butter and cinnamon.

title: Greek Yoghurt Granola & Berry Bowl
description: Thick Greek yoghurt with whey, granola and berries for an easy high-protein start.
steps: Stir the whey through the yoghurt.
Top with granola, berries and a drizzle of honey.

title: Three-Egg Veggie & Cheese Omelette
description: A fluffy omelette loaded with peppers, spinach and cheese.
steps: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Soften the pepper and spinach in the oil.
Pour in the eggs, add cheese, fold and cook through.

title: Berry Protein Pancakes
description: Light protein pancakes topped with berries and yoghurt.
steps: Blend the whey, egg, banana and oat flour into a batter.
Cook small pancakes in a non-stick pan.
Top with yoghurt and berries.

title: Avocado & Eggs on Sourdough
description: Smashed avocado and poached eggs on toasted sourdough.
steps: Toast the sourdough and smash the avocado on top with lemon and salt.
Poach or fry the eggs and set them on the avocado.
Finish with chilli flakes and pepper.

title: Berry Overnight Oats
description: Prep-ahead oats soaked with yoghurt and berries.
steps: Mix the oats, yoghurt, milk, whey and chia in a jar.
Chill overnight.
Top with berries in the morning.

title: Tofu Scramble on Toast
description: Turmeric tofu scramble with spinach on wholegrain toast.
steps: Crumble the tofu and fry in the oil with turmeric.
Wilt the spinach through.
Serve on toasted wholegrain bread.

title: Whey, Oat & Banana Smoothie
description: A drinkable breakfast — blend and go.
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

title: Egg-White & Spinach Scramble
description: A lean, high-protein scramble with a slice of toast.
steps: Scramble the eggs and whites with the spinach.
Serve with a slice of wholegrain toast.

title: Skyr, Berry & Seed Bowl
description: High-protein skyr with berries and a little granola.
steps: Top the skyr with berries, granola and seeds.

title: Grilled Chicken & Rice Bowl
description: Grilled chicken over rice with vegetables and a drizzle of olive oil.
steps: Season and grill the chicken, then slice.
Warm the rice and vegetables.
Combine in a bowl and finish with olive oil.

title: Chicken Salad Wholegrain Wrap
description: Sliced chicken and crunchy salad in a wholegrain wrap.
steps: Fill the wrap with chicken and salad.
Add the mayo, season and roll up.

title: Chicken & Quinoa Veg Bowl
description: Chicken with quinoa and roasted vegetables.
steps: Roast the vegetables and cook the quinoa.
Grill and slice the chicken.
Toss together with lemon, herbs and olive oil.

title: Chicken Fajitas
description: Spiced chicken with peppers and onions in soft tortillas.
steps: Sear the spiced chicken strips in the oil.
Add the peppers and onion until soft.
Serve in warm tortillas.

title: Roast Chicken, Potatoes & Veg
description: A classic roast plate of chicken, potatoes and greens.
steps: Roast the potatoes and chicken with oil and rosemary.
Steam the greens.
Plate together.

title: Lighter Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Grilled chicken over crisp cos with a lighter Caesar dressing and croutons.
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Toss the cos with dressing, parmesan and croutons.
Top with the chicken.

title: Beef & Veg Noodle Stir-Fry
description: Strips of beef and vegetables tossed with noodles and soy.
steps: Sear the beef and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables, then add noodles and sauce.
Return the beef and toss through.

title: Beef Burrito Bowl
description: Seasoned beef mince with rice, beans, corn and salsa.
steps: Brown the mince with the seasoning.
Build a bowl with rice, beans and corn.
Top with the beef and salsa.

title: Lean Beef Chilli with Rice
description: A hearty lean beef chilli served over rice.
steps: Brown the mince with onion and spices.
Add tomatoes and beans and simmer.
Serve over rice.

title: Beef Mince Tacos
description: Soft tacos with seasoned beef, salad and salsa.
steps: Cook the seasoned mince.
Fill the tortillas with beef, lettuce, salsa and cheese.

title: Baked Salmon, Potatoes & Greens
description: Oven-baked salmon with baby potatoes and greens.
steps: Roast the potatoes with oil.
Bake the salmon with lemon for 12–15 minutes.
Steam the greens and plate together.

title: Salmon Poke Bowl
description: Rice bowl with salmon, edamame, cucumber and a soy-sesame drizzle.
steps: Cube the salmon (cooked or sashimi-grade).
Build a bowl with rice, edamame and cucumber.
Add the salmon and the soy-sesame drizzle.

title: Tuna Pasta Salad
description: Cold pasta with tuna, sweetcorn and a light dressing.
steps: Cook and cool the pasta.
Fold through the tuna, corn, tomatoes and mayo.

title: White Fish, Greens & Sweet Potato
description: Lean baked white fish with sweet potato and greens.
steps: Roast the sweet potato.
Bake the fish with lemon and herbs.
Steam the greens and plate.

title: Prawn & Veg Noodle Stir-Fry
description: Quick prawn stir-fry with vegetables and noodles.
steps: Stir-fry the prawns with garlic and ginger.
Add vegetables and noodles with the sauce.
Toss and serve.

title: Tuna Salad Bowl
description: A big lean salad topped with tuna and a light dressing.
steps: Pile the salad into a bowl.
Top with the tuna and dress lightly.

title: Pork Chops & Sweet Potato Mash
description: Pan-seared pork chops with sweet potato mash and greens.
steps: Boil and mash the sweet potato.
Sear the pork chops in the oil.
Serve with the mash and steamed greens.

title: Lentil & Chickpea Feta Bowl
description: A hearty bowl of lentils, chickpeas, salad and feta.
steps: Combine the lentils, chickpeas and chopped salad.
Crumble over the feta.
Dress with olive oil and lemon.

title: Halloumi & Quinoa Veg Plate
description: Pan-fried halloumi with quinoa and roasted vegetables.
steps: Roast the vegetables and cook the quinoa.
Pan-fry the halloumi until golden.
Plate together with a squeeze of lemon.

title: Tofu Buddha Bowl
description: Baked tofu with rice, roasted veg and a tahini drizzle.
steps: Bake the tofu until firm.
Build a bowl with rice and roasted veg.
Add tofu and a tahini-soy drizzle.

title: Paneer Curry with Rice
description: A mild tomato paneer curry served with rice.
steps: Fry the onion and spices, add tomatoes and simmer.
Add the paneer and warm through.
Serve with rice.

title: Cottage Cheese & Pineapple
description: A simple high-protein snack.
steps: Top the cottage cheese with pineapple.

title: Whey Shake & Banana
description: A fast around-training protein hit.
steps: Shake the whey with milk and eat with a banana.

title: Greek Yoghurt & Mixed Nuts
description: Creamy yoghurt with a handful of nuts.
steps: Top the yoghurt with nuts and honey.

title: Apple & Boiled Eggs
description: A balanced grab-and-go snack.
steps: Boil the eggs ahead and pair with an apple.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
description: Wholegrain toast with peanut butter and banana.
steps: Toast the bread, spread the peanut butter and add sliced banana.

title: Protein Shake
description: A lean protein top-up.
steps: Shake the whey with water.

title: Edamame & Mixed Nuts
description: A plant-protein snack.
steps: Steam the edamame, salt lightly and serve with nuts.

title: Hummus, Veg & Crackers
description: Hummus with crunchy veg and wholegrain crackers.
steps: Serve the hummus with veg sticks and crackers.

title: Skyr with Berries
description: A low-fat, high-protein snack.
steps: Top the skyr with berries.
